name: 3M Littmann Cardiology IV Stethoscope (6200)
metaDescription: The 3M Littmann Cardiology IV stethoscope, model 6200, is a big milestone gift for a nurse who wants a serious stethoscope to carry through their career.
summary: Littmann's Cardiology IV line is a classic milestone gift, the kind of stethoscope a nurse keeps around their neck for years.
whyItWorks: Some gifts are about the job, and some are about the career. A Littmann Cardiology IV falls in the second group. It is one of the best known names in stethoscopes, and many nurses think of it as the one they will upgrade to someday. Giving it at graduation, a pinning ceremony, or the move to an ICU or cardiac unit turns that someday into a moment they will remember.

Model 6200 is one specific version in the Cardiology IV lineup, and versions mainly differ in color and finish, so check the listing photos to make sure the look suits the person. A stethoscope gets handled every shift, worn through 12 hour days, and wiped down over and over, so a recognizable, well regarded model is a gift they will use rather than store. If you are unsure whether they already own a Littmann, ask a coworker or partner quietly before buying. A personalized ID tag makes it easy to tell theirs apart at a busy nurses station.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for the tube and chestpiece colors, since the model number alone does not tell you the color.
Ask discreetly whether they already have a Cardiology IV, so you do not duplicate a gift they own.
Engraving is not mentioned in the title, so plan on a separate name tag if you want it personalized.

faq.q: Is a Cardiology IV a good gift for a new grad nurse?
faq.a: Many new grads would be thrilled with it, especially those headed to critical care or cardiac units. Some programs also suggest a simpler model for school, so ask what they currently use.

faq.q: What is the difference between 6200 and other Cardiology IV numbers?
faq.a: Littmann uses model numbers to mark different color and finish combinations. Compare the listing photos to see what the 6200 looks like.
